bucks.description: Shooter per Carson's dad. Cdub only so far, always at night. In enhanced crops from Oct 29 and Nov 2, the antler at the left of the photo shows one tall upright tine and a forward beam end with no fork. The antler at the right of the photo shows a tall upright tine and a forked beam end. That fits a missing tine on the left of the photo, but night frames can't prove a break versus how he grew. An Oct 23 buck at Cdub had a forked beam on that side; if he is the same deer, the tine was lost between Oct 23 and Oct 29. Carson identified him as a different buck from Cdub Heavy Sweep 8.
bucks.name: Broken G2
bucks.score_basis: spread ~15, beams ~19, brows ~3, standing G2 ~8, G3s ~6, mass ~30; gross counts the missing G2 as 0; side-on night frames only

bucks.description: Big-bodied 8 at Cdub. Heavy beams sweep forward, with long G2s and short brows; the rack is about ear width or a bit wider. Confirmed only in two daylight frames: 6:45 pm Sep 15 (head-on cover photo) and 6:32 pm Sep 23. Nov 9 recheck: Carson flagged the gallery as mixed, so the 10 night sightings (Sep 15 to Nov 1) were taken off him. The Nov 1 feeder buck is clearly smaller; the rest are listed as "possible" because night frames can't confirm it's him.
bucks.name: Cdub Heavy Sweep 8
bucks.score_basis: spread ~17, beams ~22, brows ~3, G2s ~10, G3s ~7, mass ~34; from Sept daylight frames, ear references

bucks.description: Medium-size typical 8 at Cdub, rack about ear width with moderate tine length. Always far from the camera at night, so it could be more than one buck.
bucks.name: Cdub Typical 8
bucks.score_basis: spread ~15, beams ~19, brows ~3, G2s ~8, G3s ~5, mass ~30; far night frames, Oct 25 head-on frame

bucks.description: Young buck with short spikes or forks and a small body. Seen in daylight at Cdub.

bucks.description: Typical 8 at Coyote, rack about ear width with moderate tines. Usually behind the feeder at night.

bucks.description: Young buck with a small 6-point basket rack (about 3 per side) well inside the ears, short tines and a light body. Split from Coyote Young Fork on Nov 6: the night frames in that group showed this bigger rack, while the daylight frames show a true fork/spike. Often feeds alongside the fork-horn and Coyote 8.

bucks.score_basis: spread ~12, beams ~15, brows ~2, G2s ~5, mass ~22; rough, night frames

bucks.description: Young buck with a small fork/spike rack well inside the ears and a thin neck. Seen in daylight at Coyote. The 6-point night frames that used to be in this group were split off on Nov 6 as Coyote Young 6.
bucks.name: Coyote Young Fork
bucks.score_basis: spread ~11, beams ~14, tines ~4, mass ~21; rough, some night frames show more points than a fork, so this group may be mixed

bucks.description: Tall, slender rack inside the ears: long main beams that turn up, each ending in a short fork, with little or no brow. Lean body. Grain Bin only.
bucks.name: GB Tall Narrow 6
bucks.score_basis: spread ~12, beams ~20, brows ~1, fork tines ~7, mass ~28; night frames

bucks.description: Typical 8 at Grain Bin with a rack outside the ears and tall G2s. Mature body. Most frames are night or backlit. Audit on Nov 8: rack shape varies between frames, so this may be more than one buck; treat counts as visits by any similar mature 8.
bucks.name: GB Wide 8
bucks.score_basis: scores the best buck in this group: spread ~18, beams ~21, brows ~4, G2s ~10, G3s ~6, mass ~33; night or backlit frames

bucks.description: Young buck with a small, thin fork-horn rack inside the ears and a light body. Seen in daylight at Grain Bin. Probably 1 or 2 young bucks.

bucks.description: GROUP, NOT ONE DEER. Audit on Nov 8: side-by-side enhanced frames show several different mature racks under this name at the Hog stand rail (2-4 bucks together on many nights, including one with long curved beams on Oct 4 and a tall three-tined rack on Oct 20). Individual visits can't be assigned to one buck, so this entry counts visits by any of them.

bucks.description: Mature buck with 5 tines per side clustered on the beam, so the rack looks crowded and tall. Wide, beyond the ears. Seen only at SOR, always at night.

bucks.description: Mature buck, 4 points per side: long brow tines, very tall G2s and G3s, main beams well outside the ears. Heavy body. CONFIRMED GROUP, NOT ONE DEER: frames on Oct 25 6:46 pm, Nov 2 8:37 pm and Nov 5 7:22 pm show 2-3 different mature 8s with tall tines at the feeder at once. At night resolution the individual sightings can't be assigned to a specific buck, so this entry counts visits by any of them. Clearest single frame of the tallest one: Nov 5 7:23 pm (SOR).
